decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - This development shall be begun within 3 years from 14 July 2017, being the date of the original planning permission.
To comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990. 
Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved drawings and specifications, unless approved otherwise in writing by the local planning authority.  
To ensure a satisfactory standard of development, and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme.
Condition : 3 - The rooflights hereby approved, shall be of a conservation area specification i.e. in-line and flush within the roof pitch that they would be located.
In the interests of preserving the character and appearance of the conservation area in accordance with Council policies DMS1 and DMS2.
Condition : 4 - The obscured screening to the roof terrace, shown on the approved drawing DC4-01 Rev C, shall be completed as approved before any use of the terrace commences, and maintained and retained permanently afterwards as approved unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.
To protect the privacy of neighbours and prevent overlooking in accordance with Council policy DMS1(c).
Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the approved plans, the flat roof of the rear of flats 3 and 4, which is not used as a patio (as shown on drawing number PL-502 Rev H and PL-506 Rev J) shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden, sitting out area or for any purpose of a similar nature without the prior written consent of the local planning authority.
To protect the privacy of neighbours and prevent overlooking, in accordance with Council policy DMS1.
Condition : 6 - The cycle parking facilities as shown of drawing number PL-501 Rev D shall be provided in full and retained to the first occupation of any of the residential units and retained and maintained as such for the life of the development.
In the interest of highway safety in accordance with policy DMT1
Condition : 7 - The waste storage area as shown on drawing number PL-501 Rev D shall be provided and retained in accordance with the approved plan prior to the first occupation of any of the residential units and maintained for the lifetime of the development.
In the interests of amenity and hygiene, in accordance with Council policy DMS1.
Condition : 8 - In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application.  We have made available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies in the Local Plan consisting of the Core Strategy, Development Management Policies Document, Supplementary Planning Documents and where appropriate the Site Specific Allocations Document as well as offering a full pre-application advice service, in order to ensure that the applicant has been given every opportunity to submit an application which is likely to be considered favourably. In addition, where appropriate, further guidance was offered to the applicant during the processing of the application.  
Condition : 9 - IMFORMATIVE: The new development will require approval/supervision by the Council of the basement construction adjoining the highway, at the applicant's expense. The applicant should contact the Council's Engineering Consultancy Services on 020 8871 6664 to obtain a cost estimate and arrange for these works to be carried out.
description: Variation of condition 2 (in accordance with approved drawings) pursuant to planning permission dated 14/07/2017 ref 2017/2899 (Variation of condition 2 (in accordance with approved drawings) pursuant to planning permission dated 16/05/2017 ref 2017/1233 [Alterations and the change of use from office (Class B1a) to residential (Class C3) including erection of a single storey rear extension, erection of mansard roof extension (with balconies to the rear), formation of roof terraces to rear; excavation to create basement; infill of existing archway, formation of refuse and cycle storage in connection with conversion to 2 x 3-bedroom, 2 x 2-bedroom and 4 x studio flats.] to create balconies over the flat roof to the rear windows and doors to flats 3 and 4 at first floor level as well as amendments to the rear windows and doors to flats 1 and 2 at ground floor level.) to allow enlargement of the balconies to flats 5 and 6 at second floor level.
